regulations.enforcement_body: Eagle County Community Development / Beaver Creek Resort Association
regulations.notes: Beaver Creek is an unincorporated gated resort community in Eagle County. As of late 2025, Eagle County has no strict STR licensing ordinance for unincorporated areas. Some HOA/resort association rules may apply within Beaver Creek itself. Note that Eagle-Vail area STRs are subject to a 1% Eagle-Vail Metro District sales tax in addition to county/state taxes.
regulations.pending_legislation: Eagle County considering full STR licensing ordinance
